entries.description: for router server, whether to automatically load models (default: enabled) (env: LLAMA_ARG_MODELS_AUTOLOAD)
entries.notes: Same spelling pair (--models-autoload / --no-models-autoload), env binding, and enabled default. With autoload off, a request naming an unloaded model answers b10621's 400 "model is not loaded"; the per-request ?autoload= query override is honored exactly as upstream's is_autoload reads it (true/1).

entries.description: directory containing models for the router server (default: disabled) (env: LLAMA_ARG_MODELS_DIR)
entries.notes: Since #1438 the flag carries b10621's router semantics: with no model argument it starts router mode over the directory (in-process model pool, discovery of checkpoint directories, load/unload/SSE routes, autoload, models-max LRU). The pre-#1438 mlxcel meaning (local model-store root) moved to the mlxcel-native --model-store-root / MLXCEL_MODELS_DIR.
divergence: Combining --models-dir with a model argument fails startup with a migration diagnostic naming --model-store-root; b10621 accepts the flag as inert outside router mode. The refusal protects deployments that relied on the flag's pre-#1438 mlxcel store-root meaning (#1438).

Router mode serves models in-process rather than as child llama-server processes, so the model objects' status.args argv list is empty and no child loaded_info keys are merged into GET /models entries (#1438).

rationale.reason: Combining --models-dir with a model argument is exactly the flag's pre-#1438 mlxcel store-root use, and honoring either meaning silently would change behavior under an operator's feet, so it fails with the map to --model-store-root (pinned by models_dir_with_a_model_argument_fails_startup_with_the_migration_map in src/server/cli_input_tests.rs). The empty status.args argv follows from router mode serving models in-process rather than as child llama-server processes, an architectural property that leaves no child argv to report.
rationale.revisit_if: the migration guard could be retired in a major release once no supported deployment still reads --models-dir as the store root; the in-process empty argv is architectural and would remain.

entries.description: for router server, maximum number of models to load simultaneously (default: 4, 0 = unlimited) (env: LLAMA_ARG_MODELS_MAX)
entries.notes: Same spelling, env binding, and default (4, 0 = unlimited). In router mode the cap is enforced with least-recently-used eviction of loaded models when a load would exceed it; a pool whose running entries are all still loading answers 503 instead of thrashing. Validated with two real checkpoints cycling through load, eviction, and reload in the #1438 PR.

entries.description: path to INI file containing model presets for the router server (default: disabled) (env: LLAMA_ARG_MODELS_PRESET)
entries.notes: Accepted on both binaries with the b10621 spelling and env binding, and refused at startup with a diagnostic: mlxcel cannot yet translate llama-server INI presets into per-model configuration, and loading un-preset models while the operator believes presets apply would be the silent-ignore failure epic #1431 exists to remove.
divergence: Any configured preset file fails startup with the migration diagnostic; b10621 loads INI presets and applies them per model (#1438).

entries.description: set model tags, comma-separated (informational, not used for routing) (env: LLAMA_ARG_TAGS)
entries.notes: Comma-separated informational tags, split with the same trim/sort/de-dup rule as --alias and reported in the /v1/models model object's tags array; never used for routing, exactly upstream's contract.

Mounted with upstream's reachable refusal surface for a models-dir pool: a missing name answers 400 "model must be a non-empty string", an unknown one 500 "model name=X is not found", and a discovered one 500 "model name=X is not removable (not from cache)", which is exactly what b10621 answers for its models_dir-sourced entries.
divergence: No cache source exists, so no model is ever removable; b10621 can delete cache-sourced models from disk (#1438).

entries.notes: Router mode serves the SSE stream with b10621's event envelope ({"model", "event"[, "data"]}) for models_reload, model_status on load begin, and status_change on load/unload transitions.
divergence: The event vocabulary is the in-process subset: download_progress / download_finished / download_failed and model_remove never occur (no cache downloads, no removable models), and status_change payloads carry status and failed only, without a child's info/progress blocks (#1438).

entries.notes: Mounted with upstream's validation surface: a missing name answers 400 "model must be a non-empty string" and an existing one 400 "model 'X' already exists".
divergence: A new model name answers a 500 diagnostic instead of starting a HuggingFace download into the cache; mlxcel's router has no cache source yet (#1438).

entries.notes: Router mode: an unknown model answers upstream's 404 "model is not found", a running one its 400 "model is already running", and a successful begin answers {"success": true} while the load proceeds through loading to loaded, observable on GET /models and the SSE stream.

Router mode: an unknown model answers 400 "model is not found", a not-running one 400 "model is not running", and success answers {"success": true}. Unload is graceful by refcount: in-flight requests hold the model's serving state until they finish, then the worker exits and the weights free.
